_doc: Ash's body (body.gd, world_data.gd wading). Stamina 0..1: run_drain a second running on land (on his bike, bike.json stamina says what riding costs); running in water costs (1 + water_drain x depth fraction) times as much; regen_walk / regen_stand a second once regen_delay s have passed since running (regen_water times that in the water); fatigue_at: the lowest part of the bar that fatigues him (no running until full). Wading: wade_fresh / wade_sea the deepest real water he walks into (m); vis_fresh scales a stream's real depth to how deep he stands in it (vis_max at most); deep: the depth at his feet counted as fully deep (speed and stamina by the fraction of it); run_water_min / walk_water_min his top speeds there (times run / walk speed). Wetness: the wet line starts wet_wick above the water and creeps up wet_creep m/s, more by wet_splash running flat out and wet_deep mid-stream; drips a second soaked through.
